name: Peloran – Sales Intelligence Engine
author: Peloran

sections.description:
Live Demo — explore the Peloran analytics panel with sample WooCommerce data before connecting your store.

Languages

This connector’s WordPress admin screens are in English. The Peloran analytics panel (after you connect your store) is available in 10 languages: English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Dutch, Portuguese, Turkish, Russian, and Arabic. Choose your language in the Peloran app under Settings after signup.

Help translate this plugin on WordPress.org: https://translate.wordpress.org/projects/wp-plugins/peloran-for-woocommerce/

Connect your WordPress or WooCommerce store to Peloran — an enterprise-grade Customer Intelligence platform built for merchants who want to understand customer behavior, increase conversions, and grow revenue with AI.

Unlike traditional analytics tools that simply report what happened, Peloran explains why visitors hesitate, abandon their carts, wait for discounts, or become loyal customers.

Using machine learning and real-time behavioral analysis, Peloran continuously transforms anonymous visitor interactions into actionable customer intelligence that powers every marketing decision.

Behavioral Intelligence includes:

• Hesitation Score™
• Discount Sensitivity Analysis
• Product Success Score
• Churn Prediction
• Customer Lifetime Value (CLV)
• Purchase Intent Detection
• Customer Value Orientation
• Returning Visitor Intelligence
• Incremental Revenue Measurement

Turn behavioral insights into automated actions with:

• AI-powered Marketing Journeys
• Personalized Popups & Offers
• Smart Customer Segmentation
• Email, WhatsApp & Web Push Campaigns
• AI Product Recommendations
• Homepage Personalization
• Predictive Audience Targeting
• Conversion Optimization

Peloran also helps merchants understand what products actually drive growth.

Product Intelligence includes:

• Product Success Score
• Inventory & Stock Calendar
• Demand Trends
• Product Performance Analytics
• Customer Interest Evolution

Unlike most marketing plugins that stop at dashboards and conversion reports, Peloran combines visitor tracking, predictive analytics, machine learning, behavioral scoring, customer intelligence, and marketing automation into a single enterprise platform.

Whether your goal is reducing cart abandonment, increasing Average Order Value, improving merchandising, or creating highly personalized customer journeys, Peloran provides the intelligence layer behind every customer interaction.

Enterprise capabilities include:

• Machine Learning Analytics
• AI Marketing Journeys
• Enterprise Visitor Tracking
• Predictive Customer Scoring
• Behavioral Segmentation
• Customer Intelligence Engine
• Incremental Revenue Analytics
• Product Intelligence
• Inventory Intelligence
• Stock Calendar
• Real-time Behavioral Analytics
• WooCommerce Integration

Turn customer behavior into measurable revenue!

This plugin is a connector to the Peloran service (Software as a Service). After you connect, your store communicates with https://app.peloran.com for order/catalog sync webhooks and optional storefront scripts used for analytics and journeys.

Two ways to get started

A) Plugin first (you found us on WordPress.org)

  1. Install and activate Peloran – Sales Intelligence Engine from this page (Plugins → Add New, or the Download button).
  2. Open WooCommerce → Peloran and click Connect and open Peloran — the plugin links your store (REST keys) and opens Peloran signup / login in one step.
  3. Create your account (or sign in). Onboarding continues with the store already linked — no return trip to WordPress.
  4. Finish imports, tracking checks, and activation in Peloran.

B) Peloran first (you registered at app.peloran.com before installing the plugin)

  1. Sign in at https://app.peloran.com/login and start WooCommerce onboarding with your store URL.
  2. Install and activate this plugin from WordPress.org before continuing:
    https://wordpress.org/plugins/peloran-for-woocommerce/
  3. In Peloran, click Connect store — WordPress opens the Peloran settings page and links automatically (no token paste for the normal flow).
  4. Onboarding steps stay locked until the plugin has linked the store. Then finish imports and activation in Peloran.

What connects where

  • Admin Connect posts your shop URL and freshly minted REST keys to Peloran’s connect API (HTTPS).
  • Storefront loads the Peloran sa-init script from an allowlisted host (app.peloran.com) only while connected.
  • Disconnect (or uninstall) stops loading the storefront script and removes local connection options.

Privacy

Connecting this plugin shares store technical data required for the Peloran service (shop URL, REST credentials minted for Peloran, webhook payloads for catalog/orders as configured on Peloran’s servers, and storefront session analytics when tracking is active).

Peloran’s privacy policy: https://www.peloran.com/privacy
Terms of use: https://www.peloran.com/terms

You can Disconnect in WooCommerce → Peloran to stop storefront script loading, or uninstall the plugin to remove local options. Revoking remote access permanently should also be done in the Peloran panel when available.
sections.installation:
Path A — Install the plugin from WordPress.org, then use Peloran

  1. Install Peloran – Sales Intelligence Engine from Plugins → Add New (search “Peloran”), or download the zip from this plugin page.
  2. Activate the plugin (WooCommerce must already be active).
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Peloran → Connect and open Peloran.
  4. Create / sign in to Peloran; the store is already linked.
  5. Finish onboarding in the Peloran panel.

Path B — Register in Peloran first, then install the plugin

  1. Create / sign in at https://app.peloran.com/login and choose WooCommerce + your store URL.
  2. Required before onboarding continues: install and activate this plugin from

    Peloran for WooCommerce


    (WordPress Admin → Plugins → Add New → search “Peloran”).

  3. In Peloran onboarding, click Connect store so WordPress opens this plugin’s settings and links the store.
  4. Return to Peloran; setup steps unlock only after the store is linked. Complete the remaining onboarding there.

After either path

  • The plugin creates WooCommerce REST API keys labeled “Peloran”.
  • Peloran registers webhooks and loads storefront tracking only after a successful connect.
  • You can Disconnect anytime under WooCommerce → Peloran.
sections.faq:
Does Peloran support my language?

The Peloran analytics panel supports English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Dutch, Portuguese, Turkish, Russian, and Arabic — switch language in the app after you connect. This WordPress connector’s admin UI is English-first; community translations for the plugin itself are welcome at https://translate.wordpress.org/projects/wp-plugins/peloran-for-woocommerce/

Do I need to create API keys manually?

No. Connecting from Peloran (Connect store) or completing link from WooCommerce → Peloran creates read/write WooCommerce REST API keys labeled “Peloran” and sends them securely to Peloran.

Do I need to paste a connect token?

No for the normal flow. Peloran opens WordPress with a one-time secure link. An advanced “paste token” field remains for emergencies.

Does the plugin track visitors before I connect?

No. Storefront scripts are enqueued only after a successful Connect.

Can I change the SaaS URL?

No. The plugin always connects to https://app.peloran.com. Arbitrary origins are rejected.

I started in Peloran but onboarding will not continue

Install and activate the plugin from WordPress.org, then use Connect and open Peloran in WooCommerce → Peloran (or Connect store if you started in the Peloran app). Wizard steps stay locked until that link succeeds.

Does Peloran store private customer data (email, phone, name, address)?

No. Peloran is designed so personally identifiable customer fields—such as email address, phone number, name, and postal address—are not persisted in Peloran’s application database. When those attributes are required for a merchant workflow (for example, identity resolution or a messaging journey), they are retrieved through live, authenticated queries against your store’s commerce APIs or equivalent real-time sources, used for the operation at hand, and not retained as a durable PII store. Session and behavioral analytics remain focused on aggregate and pseudonymous signals rather than a copy of your customer directory.

0.1.20

  • Remove WordPress Playground Preview blueprint (not a Peloran live demo — use https://app.peloran.com/demo?platform=woocommerce).

0.1.19

  • Readme: Peloran panel available in 10 languages; translate.wordpress.org link for plugin UI translations.
  • Settings page: language availability notice for the Peloran app.

0.1.18

  • Display name: Peloran – Sales Intelligence Engine (WordPress.org listing + plugin header).
  • Live Demo link on the plugin settings page and Plugins list → https://app.peloran.com/demo?platform=woocommerce

0.1.17

  • Connect handshake sends WordPress admin / store-owner email to Peloran so plugin onboarding can skip the email signup form and start at legal acknowledgement (requires Peloran app update).

0.1.16

  • WordPress.org directory: updated plugin screenshots.

0.1.15

  • WordPress.org directory: refreshed banner/screenshots under assets and listing tags (churn, journey, sales, personalization, marketing).

0.1.14

  • WordPress.org tags: churn, marketing-journey, sales, personalization, marketing.
  • FAQ: clarifies that private customer fields (email, phone, name, address) are not stored in Peloran’s database and are fetched via live queries when needed.

0.1.13

  • Logged-in WooCommerce customers: bootstrap passes customer_id and email to Peloran sa-init for identify-customer merge (fixes duplicate visitor + platform customer profiles).

0.1.12

  • Connect / re-sync buttons show a loading spinner while linking.
  • Connected stores see Peloran webhook status (Active vs Disabled) with edit links.
  • “Re-sync webhooks” re-links the store and re-enables webhooks WooCommerce auto-disabled after failed deliveries.

0.1.11

  • Connect and open Peloran: one click links the store (API keys) and opens signup/login — no bounce back to WordPress.

0.1.10

  • Open Peloran opens /login with platform=woocommerce&source=woocommerce_plugin (skips platform picker).

0.1.9

  • Connect via Peloran deep-link (no primary token paste). Status + Open / Continue in Peloran.
  • Advanced manual token paste kept for emergencies.
  • WordPress.org listing: five app screenshots; readme documents plugin-first and Peloran-first install paths.

0.1.8

  • Continue opens Peloran panel (?shop=) instead of /login (avoids Shopify install screen).
  • Plugins list: Open Peloran link to WooCommerce → Peloran settings.

0.1.7

  • After connect, show Continue in Peloran button (opens /login?shop=… in a new tab).

0.1.6

  • Hardcode SaaS origin to https://app.peloran.com (remove merchant-facing SaaS URL field).

0.1.5

  • Distinct Plugin URI (https://www.peloran.com/woocommerce) vs Author URI.

0.1.4

  • Plugin Check: use WP %i table placeholder for API key cleanup (no SQL interpolate).

0.1.3

  • Plugin Check (PCP) fixes: slug peloran-for-woocommerce, Tested up to 7.0.
  • Flash notices via transient (no query-string nonce warnings).
  • Escaped API-keys table name; script version param; prefixed uninstall vars.

0.1.2

  • WordPress.org / Plugin Check preparation: headers, readme privacy, HPOS declare.
  • Enqueue sa-init via wp_enqueue_script; allowlisted SaaS hosts only.
  • Disconnect + uninstall cleanup; translated error strings.

0.1.1

  • Connect token handshake hardening.

0.1.0

  • Initial plugin + SaaS handshake.
